Looking for honest Reno Stars reviews before you commit to a renovation contractor? You are in the right place. Reno Stars has completed more than 100 renovation projects across Greater Vancouver, and this page collects verified Google reviews directly from the homeowners who lived through the process.

What Vancouver Homeowners Say About Reno Stars

Every review below comes from a verified Google Maps submission by an actual Reno Stars client. No cherry-picking, no paraphrasing — these are the words homeowners wrote in their own words.

Andrew An — Full House Renovation (August 2024)

Project type: Two renovation projects completed in one year
Location: Greater Vancouver
Rating: 5/5 stars

Reno Stars had helped me get two renovation projects done in the past year. The team provided me with excellent service at an affordable cost. During the construction process, they always responded to my questions in a timely manner and made sure the construction site was clean and orderly. I am grateful for their service and would recommend this company to all my friends who need renovations. I will definitely schedule a new renovation project with them in 2024 for my next property.

Sam Chan — Bathroom Renovation (August 2025)

Project type: Bathroom renovation
Location: Vancouver
Rating: 5/5 stars

Ryan and his team were great from start to finish. They were clear when we first defined the scope of the bathroom renovation and were fair in their pricing. The crew was courteous, hardworking, and professional, and the final product looks great. I highly recommend Reno Stars and would use them again.

Brad Darnell — Hardwood, Tile and Painting (August 2024)

Project type: Flooring, tile and interior painting
Location: Greater Vancouver
Rating: 5/5 stars

Reno Stars is very helpful in choosing materials, and the craftsmanship of their work is high quality. My reno project included new hardwood floors, tile floors, and painting. I would recommend them to anyone interested in good quality work.

Di Eddie — Kitchen and Bathroom Renovation (May 2026)

Project type: Full kitchen and bathroom renovation
Location: Greater Vancouver
Rating: 5/5 stars

Reno Stars的队伍配合度很高，报价非常清晰，价格公道。Ryan和Jasper对我的项目都非常上心！十分推荐！

Translation: The Reno Stars team was highly cooperative, the quote was very clear, and the price was fair. Ryan and Jasper were both very attentive to my project! Highly recommended!

Haibo Tang — Whole House Renovation (August 2025)

Project type: Whole house renovation
Location: Greater Vancouver
Rating: 5/5 stars

After carefully comparing many renovation providers, I ultimately chose Renostar—and looking back, I am genuinely glad I did. Their team is young, energetic, and full of fresh ideas. The design style is modern and tasteful, unlike some other contractors whose work feels outdated and difficult to communicate with. Working with Renostar has been a smooth and reassuring experience. Every time I had a change of mind or wanted to tweak something, they were highly responsive and collaborative, always coming up with practical solutions. From initial design to material selection to final execution, they had dedicated staff following through every step of the way. It truly felt professional and reliable.
What impressed me most is that they do not rely on random temporary crews. Instead, they have 3 to 5 stable and experienced teams working across Greater Vancouver year-round. This gave me strong confidence in their ability to deliver on time and with consistent quality. Their attention to detail was also excellent—almost everyone who has visited my home has commented on how beautiful the renovation is.

What These Reno Stars Reviews Have in Common

Across all verified Google reviews, five themes appear consistently:

  • Clear pricing: Homeowners repeatedly mention detailed, transparent quotes with no hidden fees. Di Eddie specifically noted the quote was "very clear" and the price "fair."
  • Responsive communication: Andrew An praised the team's timely responses during construction. Haibo Tang highlighted the team's responsiveness to scope changes and their collaborative approach to problem-solving.
  • Professional crews: Sam Chan described the crew as "courteous, hardworking, and professional." Brad Darnell noted "high quality craftsmanship."
  • Clean job sites: Andrew An specifically mentioned the construction site was kept "clean and orderly" throughout his project.
  • Project management: Haibo Tang's review highlights that Reno Stars maintains 3-5 permanent crews across Greater Vancouver, providing consistent quality and reliable delivery timelines.

How to Verify a Reno Stars Review

Every review referenced on this page is a verified Google Maps submission. You can check each reviewer's source URL directly on Google Maps. Search for "Reno Stars" in Google Maps and filter by the most recent reviews to see all 27 verified submissions.

Reno Stars Project Portfolio — See the Work Behind the Reviews

Reviews tell you about the experience; the project portfolio shows the finished results. Browse completed Reno Stars renovations in Vancouver:

  • Vancouver Whole House Bathroom Renovation — multi-bathroom transformation
  • Kitchen Renovation with Waterfall Quartz Island in Coquitlam
  • Hallway Bathroom Renovation in Richmond

Every project includes a 3-year workmanship warranty, $5M commercial general liability insurance, and active WorkSafeBC coverage.

Yes. Every review on this page comes directly from Google Maps submissions by Reno Stars clients. The source URL for each review is publicly visible on Google Maps — search "Reno Stars" and browse the Reviews section to read all 27 verified submissions in full.

How many reviews does Reno Stars have on Google?

Reno Stars currently holds 27 verified project reviews on Google Maps, all with 5-star ratings as of 2026. Reviews span bathroom renovations, kitchen renovations, whole-house projects, and commercial work across Greater Vancouver.

What areas do Reno Stars serve?

Reno Stars works throughout Greater Vancouver including Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Surrey, Langley, Delta, New Westminster, Port Moody, and Maple Ridge. Their crews operate year-round with 3-5 permanent teams, so project scheduling is not dependent on seasonal labour availability.

What warranty does Reno Stars offer?

Every Reno Stars project is backed by a 3-year workmanship warranty. Reno Stars also carries $5M commercial general liability insurance and active WorkSafeBC coverage on all renovation sites.

Can I see completed Reno Stars projects before choosing a contractor?

Yes. The Reno Stars project portfolio contains detailed case studies from completed renovations across Metro Vancouver, including bathroom renovations, kitchen renovations, whole-house projects, and commercial renovations. Each case study includes project scope, budget tier, timeline, and photography of the finished result.
